user.title: ElectroS EV Charger (Local)
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your ElectroS charger

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to charger at the given IP/port

set_timer.name: Set charging timer
set_timer.description: Sets the charging timer in the charger and sets the charger clock to Home Assistant time. Outside the window the charger does not charge, even after a start command.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the charging window (charger local time).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the charging window. May be on the next day, e.g. 23:00–07:00.

config_entry_id.name: Charger
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when there is more than one charger.

clear_timer.name: Clear charging timer
clear_timer.description: Turns the charging timer off (the charger charges at any time) and sets the charger clock to Home Assistant time.

config_entry_id.name: Charger
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when there is more than one charger.

sync_clock.name: Sync charger clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the charger clock to Home Assistant time and keeps the timer that is in the charger now.

config_entry_id.name: Charger
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when there is more than one charger.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often Home Assistant reads the charger. Every read is a new connection to the charger.
